N = int(input())
MOD = 1000000007

class ModNumber:
    def __init__(self, v=0):
        if v < 0:
            v %= MOD
            v += MOD
        if v >= MOD:
            v %= MOD
        self.value = v

    @staticmethod
    def modInverse(a, m=MOD):
        g, r, x, y = m, a, 0, 1
        while r != 0:
            q = g // r
            g, r = r, g % r
            x, y = y, x - q * y
        return x if x >= 0 else x + m

    def __int__(self):
        return self.value

    def __iadd__(self, other):
        self.value += other.value
        if self.value >= MOD:
            self.value -= MOD
        return self

    def __isub__(self, other):
        self.value -= other.value
        if self.value < 0:
            self.value += MOD
        return self

    @staticmethod
    def fast_mod(x, m=MOD):
        return x % m

    def __imul__(self, other):
        self.value = self.fast_mod(self.value * other.value)
        return self

    def __itruediv__(self, other):
        return self.__imul__(ModNumber(self.modInverse(other.value)))

    def __add__(self, other):
        res = ModNumber(self.value)
        res += other
        return res

    def __sub__(self, other):
        res = ModNumber(self.value)
        res -= other
        return res

    def __mul__(self, other):
        res = ModNumber(self.value)
        res *= other
        return res

    def __truediv__(self, other):
        res = ModNumber(self.value)
        res /= other
        return res

    def __neg__(self):
        return ModNumber(0) if self.value == 0 else ModNumber(MOD - self.value)

    def inv(self):
        return ModNumber(self.modInverse(self.value))

    def pow(self, p):
        assert p >= 0
        base = ModNumber(self.value)
        result = ModNumber(1)
        while p > 0:
            if p & 1:
                result *= base
            base *= base
            p >>= 1
        return result

prob = [[ModNumber() for _ in range(N)] for _ in range(N)]
for i in range(N):
    row = list(map(int, input().split()))
    for j in range(N):
        prob[i][j] = ModNumber(row[j]) / ModNumber(100)

from collections import defaultdict

states = {}
init_mask = [False] * (1 << N)
init_mask[0] = True
states[tuple(init_mask)] = ModNumber(1)

for left_idx in range(N):
    new_states_map = {}
    for mask_curr in range(1 << N):
        product = ModNumber(1)
        for right_idx in range(N):
            if (mask_curr >> right_idx) & 1:
                product *= prob[left_idx][right_idx]
            else:
                product *= ModNumber(1) - prob[left_idx][right_idx]
        for possible_mask_tuple, prob_value in list(states.items()):
            possible_mask = list(possible_mask_tuple)
            temp_mask = [False] * (1 << N)
            for m in range(1 << N):
                if possible_mask[m]:
                    for i in range(N):
                        if ((mask_curr >> i) & 1) != 0 and ((m >> i) & 1) == 0:
                            temp_mask[m | (1 << i)] = True
            temp_mask_tuple = tuple(temp_mask)
            if temp_mask_tuple in new_states_map:
                new_states_map[temp_mask_tuple] += prob_value * product
            else:
                new_states_map[temp_mask_tuple] = prob_value * product
    states = new_states_map

total = ModNumber()
for mask_tuple, prob_value in states.items():
    if mask_tuple[(1 << N) - 1]:
        total += prob_value

print(int(total))
